title: Expositio in quatuor Evangelia
authorsDisplay: Anselm of Laon and his school

heads.en: MARTIANAY'S ADMONITION[n: (Opp. S. Hieronymi, tom. V.)]
HERE BEGINS THE EXPOSITION OF THE FOUR GOSPELS.

headnotes.la: *Joseph autem vir ejus.* Ideo vir ejus dicitur, et ideo justus, ne alii humanitatis conjunctionem suspicaverit
headnotes.en: *But Joseph her husband.* He is called her husband for this reason, and for this reason just, lest others should suspect a conjunction of human kind

headnotes.la: id est in judicio; ne legem transisset: quia sciebat virginem, ut diabolum partus ejus lateret
headnotes.en: that is, in judgment; lest he should transgress the law: because he knew her a virgin, that her childbearing might lie hidden from the devil
